cornerstone.notes: Verified. Cornerstone is a single investor (Fuhuida HK); clause verbatim on p164. Wording is 'six months following the Listing Date' - duration wording with no inclusive endpoint, so per convention it frees up ON the six-month anniversary (2026-07-13), last restricted day 2026-07-12. Candidate convention and dates correct.

controller_6m.notes: Verified. Re-derived independently: Rule 10.07(1)(a)-style clause located on the cited page, quote verbatim. Period 'commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of shareholding is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' - explicit inclusive endpoint ON the six-month anniversary, so last_restricted_day = anniversary and first_free_day = anniversary + 1. Date arithmetic re-checked in python. Clause verbatim on p230.

controller_12m.notes: Verified. Re-derived independently: second-period clause located on the cited page, quote verbatim. Six months commencing on the date on which the first period expires (the six-month anniversary of the Listing Date) runs to the day before the 12-month anniversary, so first_free_day = 12-month anniversary. Second period is conditional on ceasing to be a Controlling Shareholder; recorded as the standard conditional 12m controller restriction. Date arithmetic re-checked in python. Clause verbatim on p230; no 18C/18A references.
